parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of items to return per page when paginating results. The maximum is 100, and the default is 20.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
Sort Order. Possible values:

+ Ascending: Ascending order

+ Descending (default value): Descending order

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-test-task-logs --task-id stt-568c2c5a687a409b977e --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --sort-order Ascending --region cn-hangzhou
